Tomato___Early_blight.fertilizer: Apply potassium-rich fertilizer to strengthen the plant
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Remove infected leaves, avoid watering from above, rotate crops each season

Tomato___Late_blight.fertilizer: Avoid excess nitrogen. Use balanced NPK soil additives
Tomato___Late_blight.pesticide: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb as soon as conditions are wet and cool
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Destroy culled potatoes, keep foliage dry, space plants well

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.fertilizer: Maintain balanced fertility to ensure robust growth
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Ensure good ventilation, reduce humidity, prune lower leaves

Tomato___healthy.fertilizer: Continue current regular feeding with balanced nutrients
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Maintain consistent watering and watch for pests

Potato___Early_blight.fertilizer: Ensure adequate nitrogen and phosphorus throughout the season
Potato___Early_blight.pesticide: Use azoxystrobin or chlorothalonil during early detection
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Use certified seed, allow tubers to mature fully before harvest

Potato___Late_blight.fertilizer: Avoid over-fertilizing with nitrogen to prevent lush, vulnerable canopies
Potato___Late_blight.pesticide: Apply preventative fungicides immediately when cool, wet weather persists
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Remove volunteer potatoes, plant resistant varieties

Potato___healthy.fertilizer: Apply standard recommended NPK for potatoes
Potato___healthy.prevention: Keep weeds under control and maintain even soil moisture

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.fertilizer: Use balanced fertilizer. High nitrogen can increase rust severity
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.pesticide: Foliar fungicides applied prior to silking if infection is severe
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Plant rust-resistant hybrids, manage crop residue

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.pesticide: Apply appropriate fungicides like pyraclostrobin if lesions spread
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Rotate crops with non-hosts, plow under debris to reduce inoculum

Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Keep field free of excessive weeds

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.fertilizer: Maintain balanced fertility without excessive nitrogen
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.pesticide: Apply copper bactericide combined with mancozeb for maximum effect
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds and avoid overhead irrigation

Pepper,_bell___healthy.fertilizer: Use calcium and magnesium rich fertilizers to prevent blossom end rot
Pepper,_bell___healthy.prevention: Mulch soil and ensure even watering
